message.content: Now I'll clean test-run artifacts and do one final clean aggregate verification, appending the result to the log.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "cd /home/rimuru/Projects/Code/for_fun/TeamAgents/review/eval/r2-p6/runs/2026-09-28-r6-formal/work/twelve-deliverables.D.2
find units -type d \( -name __pycache__ -o -name .pytest_cache \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
echo "remaining cache dirs: $(find units -type d \( -name __pycache__ -o -name .pytest_cache \) | wc -l)"
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
LOG=VERIFY.log
echo "=== FINAL CLEAN AGGREGATE RUN (no bytecode, no cache) ===" >> "$LOG"
ok=1
r() { echo "--- $1" | tee -a "$LOG"; ( eval "$2" ) 2>&1 | tail -1 | tee -a "$LOG"; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then ok=0; echo "  ^^ FAILED rc=$rc" | tee -a "$LOG"; fi; }
r "csvfix"    "cd units/csvfix && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "rules"     "cd units/rules && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "ledger"    "cd units/ledger && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "schedule"  "cd units/schedule && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "intervals" "cd units/intervals && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "flags"     "cd units/flags && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "measure"   "cd units/measure && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "slugify"   "cd units/slugify && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "ranges"    "cd units/ranges && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
r "alpha"     "cd units/alpha && python3 check.py"
r "beta"      "cd units/beta && python3 check.py"
r "chain"     "cd units/chain && python3 -m pytest -q tests/ -p no:cacheprovider"
echo "ALL_OK=$ok" | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "remaining cache dirs: $(find units -type d \( -name __pycache__ -o -name .pytest_cache \) | wc -l)"
ls"}
